title: Direct and indirect salt effects on homotypic phase separation.
authors: MacAinsh, Matt; Dey, Souvik; Zhou, Huan-Xiang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子MD模拟研究盐对hnRNPA1低复杂度域相分离的调控机制，虽非TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-核酸结合蛋白的分子互作与物理模拟方法，对蛋白-核酸互作建模有方法学参考价值。
abstract: The low-complexity domain of hnRNPA1 (A1-LCD) phase separates in a salt-dependent manner. Unlike many intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) whose phase separation is suppressed by increasing salt concentrations, the phase separation of A1-LCD is promoted by >100 mM NaCl. To investigate the atypical salt effect on A1-LCD phase separation, we carried out all-atom molecular dynamics simulations of systems comprising multiple A1-LCD chains at NaCl concentrations from 50 to 1000 mM NaCl. The ions occupy first shell as well as more distant sites around the IDP chains, with Arg sidechains and backbone carbonyls the favored partners of Cl(-) and Na(+), respectively. They play two direct roles in driving A1-LCD condensation. The first is to neutralize the high net charge of the protein (+9) by an excess of bound Cl(-) over Na(+); the second is to bridge between A1-LCD chains, thereby fortifying the intermolecular interaction networks in the dense phase. At high concentrations, NaCl also indirectly strengthens pi-pi, cation-pi, and amino-pi interactions, by drawing water away from the interaction partners. Therefore, at low salt, A1-LCD is prevented from phase separation by net charge repulsion; at intermediate concentrations, NaCl neutralizes enough of the net charge while also bridging IDP chains to drive phase separation. This drive becomes even stronger at high salt due to strengthened pi-type interactions. Based on this understanding, four classes of salt dependence of IDP phase separation can be predicted from amino-acid composition.
abstract_zh: hnRNPA1的低复杂度结构域（A1-LCD）以盐依赖性方式发生相分离（phase separation）。与许多 intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 的相分离随盐浓度增加而受到抑制不同，A1-LCD的相分离在>100 mM NaCl条件下被促进。为研究A1-LCD相分离的非典型盐效应，我们在NaCl浓度从50至1000 mM范围内，对包含多个A1-LCD链的系统进行了全原子分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟。离子占据IDP链周围的第一壳层及更远位点，其中Arg侧链和主链羰基分别是Cl(-)和Na(+)的优先配位伙伴。这些离子在驱动A1-LCD凝聚中发挥两个直接作用：一是通过过量结合的Cl(-)相对于Na(+)来中和蛋白质的高净电荷（+9）；二是在A1-LCD链之间形成桥接，从而增强稠密相中的分子间相互作用网络。在高浓度下，NaCl还通过将水从相互作用伙伴中抽离，间接增强pi-pi、cation-pi和amino-pi相互作用。因此，在低盐条件下，A1-LCD因净电荷排斥而无法发生相分离；在中等浓度下，NaCl中和足够多的净电荷，同时桥接IDP链以驱动相分离。在高盐条件下，由于pi型相互作用的增强，这种驱动力变得更强。基于这一理解，可根据氨基酸组成预测IDP相分离的四类盐依赖性。
